description: Prepare a new monthly budget for one campaign, in whole units of the account currency (3000 = 3000.00, never cents or micros); the preview shows the daily amount and the figure the platform receives. Changes nothing: returns a preview_id (15 min, one use) for execute_prepared_change.

campaign_id.description: ADS Beast id from list_campaigns, not the platform's.

currency.description: ISO code of the currency you believe the account uses, for example EUR. Optional safety check: the call is refused when it differs from the account's currency.

new_monthly_budget.description: New monthly budget in the ad account's currency, whole units. 3000 means 3000.00 of that currency.

reason.description: Why, with numbers (shown to the approver).

name: prepare_campaign_budget_change
